premises.text: College students struggle to get on-demand help, find study groups, and share knowledge, widening the achievement gap
premises.evidence_span: It's really hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand. It's hard to find study groups if students cannot easily share knowledge or resources

premises.text: School-email signup connects students to classmates and course pages for collaborative study
premises.evidence_span: any student can easily access the brainpower and knowledge of their entire class right on our platform

premises.text: Course pages support collaborative study guides, section selection, and free shared files including prior semesters
premises.evidence_span: Michael can have access to all the files and resources shared by his classmates completely and absolutely free

premises.text: Campus founders plus first-day marketing and student invites drive viral campus adoption
premises.evidence_span: we put together a campus founder program, and we do a big marketing and social media push the first day of class. After that, it's the students inviting their classmates

premises.text: Peer Mentor Program offers scalable affordable on-demand peer tutoring on course pages
premises.evidence_span: allow every single college student to offer online, on-demand tutoring sessions and make some money while helping others

premises.text: Platform knowledge of when and which subject students need help enables highly targeted mentor matching
premises.evidence_span: we know exactly when they need help. We know exactly the subject they need help with, and that allows us to be highly targeted like no other

value.text: College students get on-demand peer help and shared class knowledge
value.evidence_span: access the brainpower and knowledge of their entire class right on our platform

secondary_value.text: Students can earn money as peer mentors while peers get cheap one-on-one help
secondary_value.evidence_span: a way for students to make some money for college and a way for every single college student to get personalized one-on-one help

causal_links.evidence_span: we know exactly when they need help. We know exactly the subject they need help with, and that allows us to be highly targeted like no other
It's really hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand
Students learn best by helping each other out, and that is exactly what they're doing on Study Room
get personalized one-on-one help right when they need it

notes: Help-on-demand / study-groups / achievement-gap pains folded as one student problem set. Collaborative guide, sections, and free files treated as facets of the class platform surface. Peer mentoring is a separately framed second product path. 40k student traction excluded per §4.2. Singleton D1 retained as independently stated demand module. Trailing Q&A excluded.
